prompt.en: One 2-of-3 signer loses a key. What else must hold for recovery?
prompt.sw: Msaini mmoja wa 2 kati ya 3 amepoteza ufunguo. Nini kingine kinahitajika?

label.en: Only a note saying two of three
The remaining keys and needed wallet configuration are available
label.sw: Funguo zilizobaki na mpangilio unaohitajika vinapatikana

explanation.en: Threshold availability includes usable independent keys and compatible recovery metadata.
explanation.sw: Upatikanaji unahitaji funguo huru zinazotumika na taarifa za urejeshaji zinazolingana.

prompt.en: Which is not a true 2-of-3 arrangement?
prompt.sw: Upi si mpangilio halisi wa 2 kati ya 3?

label.en: Three independent spending keys under a threshold policy
label.sw: Funguo tatu huru chini ya sera ya kiwango

label.en: Three copies of the same single key

explanation.en: Copies add backups, not independent signature requirements.
explanation.sw: Nakala huongeza hifadhi, si mahitaji huru ya sahihi.

prompt.en: What can two colluding signers do in ordinary 2-of-3 custody?
prompt.sw: Wasaini wawili wanaoshirikiana kuiba wanaweza kufanya nini katika 2 kati ya 3 ya kawaida?

label.sw: Kutimizia sheria ya mirathi moja kwa moja

explanation.en: A spending threshold does not enforce the whole governance or legal process.
explanation.sw: Kiwango cha sahihi hakitekelezi utawala au mchakato wote wa sheria.

prompt.en: What should an inheritance plan address separately from key access?
prompt.sw: Mpango wa urithi ushughulikie nini tofauti na kufikia funguo?

label.en: Lawful authority, entitlement and applicable local requirements
label.sw: Mamlaka halali, haki na masharti ya eneo husika

explanation.en: Local qualified review is needed; technical recovery is not a legal succession template.
explanation.sw: Uhakiki wa mtaalamu wa eneo unahitajika; urejeshaji wa kiufundi si kiolezo cha sheria ya urithi.
